note:
Bootstrap Utilities provides four core filter plugins that add Bootstrap CSS classes to editor HTML on output: bootstrap_utilities_table_filter (adds 'table' + optional table-striped/table-bordered/table-hover/table-sm, and can strip width/height on tbody cells - the only filter with settings), bootstrap_utilities_image_filter (img-fluid on ), bootstrap_utilities_blockquote_filter (blockquote on
), bootstrap_utilities_figure_filter (figure/figure-caption). They are enabled per text format (filter.format. config) at /admin/config/content/formats; no dedicated config page (configure=null), no permissions/services/Drush. Medium introspection finds which text format has the table filter enabled; hard execution enables the image filter on a given text format, verified against the live filter.format config.

evals.prompt: What do the Bootstrap Utilities module's filters do, and which Bootstrap CSS classes do they add to images and tables?
evals.expected_output: They are text-format filters that automatically add Bootstrap classes to editor HTML on output: the image filter adds img-fluid to , the table filter adds table (plus optional table-striped/table-bordered/table-hover/table-sm), the blockquote filter adds blockquote, and the figure filter adds figure/figure-caption.

evals.prompt: How do I turn on the Bootstrap Utilities table styling for content, and where is that configured in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: Enable the 'Bootstrap Utilities - Table Classes' filter on a text format at Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors (/admin/config/content/formats/manage/<format>), in the Enabled filters list. There is no separate settings page - it is configured per text format.

evals.prompt: Which of the Bootstrap Utilities filters has its own settings, and what options can you toggle on it?
evals.expected_output: Only the Table filter (bootstrap_utilities_table_filter) has settings: striped rows (table-striped), bordered (table-bordered), hoverable rows (table-hover), small (table-sm), and removing width/height attributes from table cells. The other three filters (image, blockquote, figure) are simple on/off.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one text format has the Bootstrap Utilities table-classes filter enabled. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of that text format.
evals.expected_output: The text format is buty_format: in filter.format.buty_format the bootstrap_utilities_table_filter is enabled (status true, with striped rows on). Find it e.g. via drush cget on filter.format.* or by listing filter formats.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name buty_task. Using the Bootstrap Utilities module, enable the responsive-image filter on that text format so that images in content it renders get the img-fluid class. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Enable the bootstrap_utilities_image_filter on the buty_task text format (status true) - e.g. tick 'Bootstrap Utilities - Responsive Image Class' on /admin/config/content/formats/manage/buty_task, or FilterFormat::load('buty_task')->setFilterConfig('bootstrap_utilities_image_filter', ['status' => TRUE, 'weight' => 10, 'settings' => []])->save().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one text format has the Bootstrap Utilities responsive-image filter enabled. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of that text format.
evals.expected_output: The text format is buty_img: in filter.format.buty_img the bootstrap_utilities_image_filter is enabled (status true).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a text format with machine name buty_tbl that already has the Bootstrap Utilities table-classes filter enabled, but with striped rows turned off. Turn on striped rows (the table-striped option) for that filter on the buty_tbl format. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: On filter.format.buty_tbl, set the bootstrap_utilities_table_filter setting table_row_striping to TRUE (the 'Striped rows' checkbox), keeping the filter enabled, so tables also get the table-striped class.
